text:
To undo your last git commit but keep the changes in your working tree, use:

```bash
git reset --soft HEAD~1
```

This moves HEAD back one commit while keeping the changes staged in the index.

**Options:**
- `git reset --soft HEAD~1` — Changes remain **staged** (ready to commit)
- `git reset --mixed HEAD~1` — Changes **unstaged** but still in working tree (default)
- `git reset --hard HEAD~1` — **Deletes** the commit and all changes ⚠️

If you want the changes completely unstaged:
```bash
git reset HEAD~1
```
